findings.evidenceJa: 早速昼食に致しましょう
findings.governingReading: Saber abruptly switches to the conspicuously formal 致しましょう, prompting Shirou to question her wording.
findings.explanation: The ordinary let us eat removes the local register shift on which the next reaction depends.

findings.highlight: Saber… you’re acting a bit strange.
findings.evidenceJa: 致しましょうって、セイバー……なんか、微妙に言葉遣い違くないか？
findings.governingReading: Shirou quotes Saber’s 致しましょう and asks whether her wording has subtly changed.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the observation to strange behavior and deletes the specific speech evidence.
